title: Kissed Roasted Peruvian Lamb Seco De Cordero
description: A roasted Peruvian lamb dish featuring mozzarella balls and a blend of spices, perfect for a special occasion. This flexitarian-friendly recipe is sure to impress.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine garlic, ginger, aji amarillo pepper, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to make a spice paste.
Rub the spice paste all over the lamb shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat and sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast the lamb for 20 minutes per pound, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the lamb is roasting, grill the mozzarella balls until they are lightly charred and softened.
Once the lamb is cooked, let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Serve the sliced lamb with the grilled mozzarella balls and your choice of sides.
Garnish with fresh herbs and serve immediately.
